primitive_hypotheses.raw_fourier_maps: rhoInf on cusp times height times natural frequency; rhoOne on cusp times height times integer frequency, each measurable in the continuous point. No assertion that arbitrary maps are Eisenstein coefficients.
primitive_hypotheses.local_integrability: For every real T>=1, both actual finite packet functionals are MemLp2 for the restricted all-cusp positive measure.
primitive_hypotheses.cumulative_M: For every real T>=1, exact cusp sum integral_-T^T norm(M(-k))^2/cosh(pi*t) <= (T^2+V^(1+epsilon)/z)*(C1*sum original completed coefficient norm^2).
primitive_hypotheses.cumulative_N: For every real T>=1, exact cusp sum integral_-T^T norm(N(k))^2/cosh(pi*t) <= (T^2+(U/nu)^(1+epsilon)/z)*(C2*sum original signed mode coefficient norm^2).
primitive_hypotheses.transform: H is measurable; low bound C*(1+abs(log Y0))/(1+Y0) for abs(t)<=max1(2Y0), including t=0; high bound C*(abs(t)^(-5/2)+Y0*abs(t)^(-3)) thereafter.
primitive_hypotheses.constants_and_quantifiers: C,C1,C2 are nonnegative and fixed before the forall T hypotheses. The theorem is at a fixed actual P,k,r,z; a common constant over the full level/residue/nu family is not assumed to have been instantiated.
